name: hfs-journal-interruption
purpose: Journaled HFS+/HFSX volumes captured mid-transaction in four journal shapes (linear, wrapped, complete tail, incomplete tail) by pausing the disk image helper, together with Apple's own replay of each: journal inspection and replay must reproduce Apple's result byte for byte.

versionNotes.helper: The image helper process is diskimages-helper or diskimagesiod depending on the macOS version; the tool matches either.

fs.content: Signed resource preserved by image construction.
